title: Cluster 02 DRILL: Effects on the Environment and on Organisms
subtitle: H2 Biology 9477 · Book 8, Extension Topic B · 9 questions · 90 marks · 31 parts · one mark per minute, so about an hour and a half · every question is an actual exam paper question

One primary concept each, checked for duplicated required answers as well as duplicated labels. Q1 why mangrove sediment stores carbon, and mitigation held apart from adaptation · Q2 the coral chain end to end, symbiosis to bleaching to a dissolving skeleton · Q3 classifying a feedback network that is printed on the paper · Q4 LO (b)'s physical effects as short causal chains attached to real data · Q5 what a data quote has to contain, at the granularity the scheme states · Q6 range shift read off a new figure, and the limits of the inference · Q7 two species shifting in opposite directions and the mismatch that follows · Q8 the insect temperature curve, up and then down · Q9 the LO (b) sweep at full essay length.

The two deliberately shared marking points, declared. First, heat stress makes coral polyps expel their zooxanthellae, so the coral loses its photosynthetic food supply and starves, which Q2(b) and Q2(c) need as mechanism and Q9 needs as one of thirteen possible marks in a category that requires two; the three are marked on different things, the sequence, the proximate trigger, and breadth across categories. Second, increased temperature raises insect metabolic rate and shortens the life cycle, which Q7(b) needs for caterpillars and Q8(b) needs as one of five impacts; Q7(b) is marked on tying it to a dated phenological shift and Q8(b) on breadth with a direction of change attached to each. Every other required answer in the set is unique.

Nothing from Book 9, and nothing from Cluster 1 or Cluster 3. The carbon cycle, carbon footprints and the greenhouse mechanism itself are Cluster 1 and are assumed here rather than retested. Food security, biodiversity of the tropics, the Aedes aegypti life cycle and the spread of dengue beyond the tropics are Cluster 3. Dengue virology, serotypes and the host immune response are Extension Topic A and are out of scope for Book 8 entirely.
